identity.name: Drawlead Construction ERP
principles: One brand colour (#32B46F) for actions, selection and focus; status colours only carry meaning
Flat surfaces — no gradients; soft borders and layered shadows
Data is the hero: tabular figures, uppercase table heads, dense but breathable
Dark ink sidebar shell, light canvas content

scales.brand: brand-50…950 (500 = #32B46F); green and emerald alias brand
scales.ink: ink-50…950; gray and slate alias ink

colors.gradients: none — use flat tints (bg-*-50) or ink tiles

shell.desktop: Fixed dark sidebar (16rem, collapsible to 4.5rem rail) rendered by AppHeader + sticky blurred top bar with page title
shell.mobile: Top bar with hamburger drawer + MobileBottomNav

inputs.base: h-9 rounded-lg border-input bg-background shadow-xs hover:border-ink-300 focus-visible:border-primary focus-visible:ring-4 focus-visible:ring-ring/15

tabs.segmented: TabsList rounded-xl bg-muted p-1; active trigger bg-background shadow-sm

tables.head: text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.06em] text-muted-foreground bg-muted/60

visual_enhancers.shadows: tailwind shadow-xs…2xl (tinted ink), shadow-brand for brand glow

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME: tokens live in frontend/src/index.css (:root/.dark) and tailwind.config.js — never hard-code the brand hex in pages; use bg-primary / text-primary-strong / brand-*.
3. ACTIONS: primary actions use the default <Button>; destructive stays red; avoid per-page rainbow button colours.
4. STATUS COLOURS: amber = pending/warning, red = error/rejected, green = done/income; categorical chips may use other hues as pale tints.
5. NAVIGATION: AppHeader renders the sidebar + top bar; pages only pass customNav/headerActions/backTo/hideNav.
6. MOBILE FIRST: stack forms/dashboards on mobile; large touch targets on site flows.
7. DATA-TESTID: add data-testid to every interactive element.
universal_guidelines: No gradients — flat tints and ink tiles.
Selected/active state = brand green (tint or solid).
Respect dark mode: prefer tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, border-border) over raw white/gray.
